notes.title: Update 1.0.2 - Replace NTR content with normal content, ToW2 coming soon!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We realized that many players hate the NTR content of the final waifu (the 10th floor). So we decided to make a small change for that girl. We remove the NTR content and replace it with normal content for her.
We are also sorry for players who like previous content more than new content but we don’t want to have both in the game. Hope you will like the replaced content.
We are also happy to announce that Tower of Waifus 2 will be coming next month with Helltaker-like gameplay.
Don't forget to support us by adding it to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1560770/Tower_of_Waifus_2

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 and copyright problem explanation
notes.content:
[b]We updated the game to version 1.0.1 and here is release note:[/b]
1. Added dialog that let you choose to skip or begin the game with tutorial
2. Added an arrow icon next to the FREE spell for easier to realize.
3. Added an auto Win button in the battle for anyone who doesn't want to play it.
4. Minor bug fixes

[b]We see a lot of negative review said us stolen assets from other game, other studio, so we have an explanation for everyone who cares about this problem:[/b]
1. All of the music and art was bought from the same store or hiring artist to draw, we are not stealing anything from any games. This is a common way to develop games for indie studios like us because of limited budgets. Everything is licensed, we just use the same assets.
2. Someone tells us stolen assets from Mature Games, but they are our partner, you can see they have cross promotion for us on their media channel (steam announcement, twitter, discord...).
3. You can find these assets from link of original author (where we bought)
- Music: https://wowsound.com/
- Enemy Arts: https://assetstore.unity.com/publishers/22539
Hope you understand and continue supporting us.
